The '''Deeptide Sanctum''' is a naga-infested island located off the shore of [[Gillijim's Isle]]. When the [[Kul Tiran Exploratory Fleet]] attempted to make berth on the island of Gillijim, the Deeptide naga attacked them, destroying the high elven vessels at [[Faelon's Folly]] and, in spite of the Kul Tirans' victory, forced them to relocated to [[Lapidis Isle]] further to the north.<ref>{{questlong|Alliance|53|Drowning Deeptide}}</ref>
